dogecoin.text: @EthereumAddict $DOGE was never really pumped on trex, last pump was on polo, so yeah volume profile on trex let you think it's the greatest ever, but it's in fact on the same scale BTC wise than the april/may one.

The only thing that stands out like a sore thumb is $DOGE which is very stable in the sub 30 sat range.
I expected a big move if we were heading in a "true" alt season, but markets are completely different than even 1 year ago, so maybe not this time?
Will monitor.
